7580: Kaori's brother and one of the first persons to find out about the existence of Shiki. He becomes a friend of Natsuno.
7581: A girl attending the same school as Natsuno, Megumi hates living in the village and longs for city life. She has a one-sided crush on Natsuno and often daydreams of a relationship with him. Megumi encounters the Kirishiki family in the beginning of the series.
7582: Natsuno lives and attends school in Sotoba. He hates living in the village and prefers to be in the city. Originally a city dweller, Natsuno reluctantly moves to Sotoba with his parents when they wanted a change of environment.
7583: The dean of the hospital in Sotoba, Toshio resigned from university hospital, returning to take up his father's position when he passed away. He is fondly given a nickname, "Waka-sensei", by his colleagues as well as the residents.
7584: Seishin is the local priest in Sotoba, as well as an author in writing novels. His latest work is called Shiki, which translated in English is called Corpse Demon. He has a sense of the supernatural and detects the presence of the real "shiki.
30477: A young girl who moves into the Kanemasa mansion atop the hill with her family. She has a rare genetic disorder known as SLE, which leads her to stay inside her home during the day and only come out at night.
30478: Natsuno's best friend. He has a slight crush on the nurse, Ritsuko.
30499: Shimizu Megumi's childhood friend, though the sentiment is one-sided on her part, as Megumi is disgusted by the Sotoba villagers in general and doesn't think any more highly of Kaori.
30500: Nurse at Ozaki Clinic. She has a dog named Taro. Tohru has a crush on her. She used to have a boyfriend, who disliked the isolated Sotoba village, and offered to marry her and bring her to the city.
32724: The happy go lucky servant to the Kirishiki family. However, there's more to him than meets the eye...
33456: He's friend with the Mutou siblings (especially Tohru) and hates Natsuno.
35991: Toshio and Seishin's childhood friend and Nao's husband. He and Nao have a son named Susumu.
36113: The self proclaimed shaman of the village, though treated as if she's crazy.
36126: Father of Ozaki Toshio. He takes pride in his family name, being the doctor who takes care of the village's welfare, and expects Toshio to follow his example. However, Toshio only considers him an arrogant and irritating man.
36127: The owner of the liquor store. Tomio is an intimidating man and disciplines his son with an iron fist.
36493: Wife of Yasumori Tokujirou of the second branch of the Yasumori family.
36781: The son of the owner of Ookawa's wine shop. He receives strict upbringing from his parents.
37826: Kanami is the owner of a roadside restaurant, Chigusa.
37858: A nurse in Ozaki´s clinic, Yasuyo is Ritsuko's best friend.
37859: A female servant of the Kirishiki family.
38189: An exceptionally extravagant Shiki who aids in the Kirishiki family's plans by running their fake funeral home service.
38192: An English teacher of the local school. He frequents the village bar. Like others who receive hints from Ozaki Toshio about the existence of the Shiki, he refuses to believe Toshio, claiming he has been baptized by modern science belief.
39593: The brother of Tohru and Aoi.
39608: A housewife from Lower Sotoba who works in drive-in Chigusa. She's xenophobic to the point of unhinged mentality, and forbids her children to play near the motorway as she believes the outsiders will take them away.
41636: Murasako Munetaka's wife and Murasako Masao's sister-in-law. She has two children with Munetaka, and her son Hiromi is later killed by a Shiki.
